Prequels placed first, following Asimov's own author's note in Prelude to Foundation (1988), which lists the books in story order because they 'were not written in the order in which (perhaps) they should be read'; Forward the Foundation (1993) came after the note but is set between Prelude and Foundation. Publication order would instead be: Foundation, Foundation and Empire, Second Foundation, Foundation's Edge, Foundation and Earth, Prelude to Foundation, Forward the Foundation.
